name: Euphoria (2)
body:
School enchantment (charm) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 move action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one humanoid creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Your voice fills the target with feelings of pleasure and joy. A target NPC who fail his save has his attitude improved by one step (to a maximum of helpful). In addition, the target takes a -2 penalty on all saving throws against enchantment spells and effects cast by you for the duration of euphoria. Regardless of the success or failure of the save, the target is unaware that a spell has been cast.
